name: Eventbrite Amsterdam
api: GET /d/netherlands--amsterdam/{events,nightlife--events}/ (server-rendered __SERVER_DATA__ cards + schema.org ItemList) + GET /e/<slug> detail JSON-LD for items without a time

robots.note: User-agent * does not disallow /d/ or /e/. It disallows /directory/, /api/v3/destination/events/ (the pagination API) and several query-string patterns (?x, ?i, &id ...): no URL with a query string is requested, so only the first page of each listing is read.

tos.note: The Eventbrite Terms of Service restrict automated access to the service without permission. Public pages only, no login, no user data, 2 s between requests, about 10 requests per run.

risk.note: ToS restrict automated access. Owner decision of 27/11/2026 to switch it on (the Apify actor it replaces ran out of keys). Likely consequence: an IP block of the runner. Events keep a link back to the Eventbrite page. Switch off: scraping_sources.is_active=false or OUTLIST_PRIMARY_EVENTBRITE=off.

built_with.method: manual inspection of the public pages (no login)
